notes.title: Robot Gentleman announces their new game: 60 Seconds! Souper Scavenger.
notes.content:
[p]All you soup lovers, this is not a drill!  Robot Gentleman, creators of the dark comedy postapocalyptic series 60!, invite you to visit the atomic wasteland once again in [i][u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3197360/60_Seconds_Souper_Scavenger/"]60 Seconds! Souper Scavenger[/url][/u][/i]. Watch the teaser trailer and prepare for the endless soup scavenge run! And plenty of fun![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/7Wv5aMhRBPw"][/dynamiclink]The McDoodle family survived the nuclear apocalypse in the safety of their fallout shelter. But their troubles are far from over. Supplies are running low, and soup is all but gone. Someone has to step up and venture into the hostile wasteland to scavenge.[/p][p]How about... Mary Jane?[/p][list][*][p]RUN & JUMP your way through the procedurally generated wasteland. No one can stop you. But they will try.[/p][/*][*][p]SCAVENGE soup, supplies, and even grab friends to join your endless run (disclaimer: until you perish).[/p][/*][*][p]SURVIVE the deadly hazards of the wasteland. Raiders, ill-parked bicycles, remains of the collapsed civilization, mutant marathons, and many more.[/p][/*][*][p]VISIT all the incredible postapocalyptic, only ever so slightly radioactive locations, and enjoy the sights. And of course, all the soup you can find there![/p][/*][*][p]RUN AGAIN and again, because it will take more than one try to stock that fallout shelter of yours.[/p][/*][/list][p]No time to waste! Run, Mary Jane, run![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3197360/60_Seconds_Souper_Scavenger/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i]60 Seconds! Souper Scavenger[/i] will give you a chance to experience what scavenging in the atomic wasteland really feels like. This one of a kind endless runner will provide crazy replayability, gorgeous hand-drawn animations, weird environments to perish in, and of course plenty of soup. It is also Robot Gentleman's first title to be developed with the open-source Godot game engine.[/p][p]Remember: it's all about SOUP.[/p][p]Don’t ever miss out on news from Robot Gentleman! Make sure you’re [u][url="https://robotgentleman.com/#contact"]subscribed to the studio's newsletter[/url][/u], follow the [u][url="https://linktr.ee/robotgentleman"]studio's social channels[/url][/u], and join our [u][url="https://discord.gg/UvjzDFwr"]Discord server[/url][/u]![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Space Adventures - the final frontier!
notes.content:
The atomic space age survival 60 Parsecs! returns with new and even more twisted adventures of exploring strange galaxies. The brave Astrocitizens will come face to face with monstrous horrors from unknown dimensions, run the greatest heist the universe has seen, speak some French and even raise an AI of their own. 

🇫🇷 Liberté, Égalité, Félinité -  Let out of the bag by the French government, the glorious Astrocats explore the cosmos stirring trouble in search of the one comfortable place to land and lie down for a nap. Do you have what it takes to assist? Merci in advance.

☠️ Who let the muttniks out? - A rogue pack of space dogs is on the prowl. Think you can fly with them and keep up? Think again, comrade silly human-person. This here is a real job. The greatest heist this galaxy has ever seen! Want in? Prove yourself first. Ready? Go... FETCH!

🛸 SF is for space family - It takes a capable captain and their trusty AI to birth new sentience. Can the two of you survive the perils of the cosmos and accidental parenthood, while raising a UFO from its infancy? You might want it to become a respectable spaceship, but what if it chooses to be a galactic menace? WHAT IF?! YOU'RE NOT MY FATHER, CAPTAIN DAD!

👾 The Horrors of Space - Have you ever experienced true horror? No, that time when your soup fought back does not count. Not by a long shot. Beware of the void, dear captain. The void where dark creatures lurk and no one can hear you scream. The horror, the horror!

Can you survive that and more? Launch into 60 Parsecs! and try for yourself! 
Let's go, Astrocitizens!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30837263/15ea4b078a1d3dd5cd00c191304cc5f75cc07c9f.png[/img]

+++ 25/07/2022 - Space Adventures free content update:

New off-planet stories and endings:
- 1 new gameplay stage/element
- 11 new Space events
- 5 new Space Monsters (10 new monster events & 5 new visuals)
- 3 new questlines (14 new endings)
- 4 new achievements
- 3 new music pieces and new SFX
+ Main menu art revamp
+ 2 updated ending visuals


*Due to the introduction of new design elements and other changes, old save games will become invalid after updating the game.

Astrocitizens, get ready for a new mission!

As the solar winds carry our space shuttles and tomato soup fills our bellies, we’re entering a new constellation. The space is vast, the stars are bright and they look pretty familiar… no, it’s not a hamster and it’s not a mouse, either. It’s a rat!

We’re celebrating the Lunar Steam Sale with a constellation worth of updates! Not only can you get 60 Parsecs! at 75% off during the sale, but there’s a NEW MISSION available FOR FREE!!! But that’s not all – Japanese language option has also been added! We even managed to squeeze in some bugfixes and balance changes this time round, too.

Here’s all the shiny details:

🚀 [u][b]23/01/2020 1.1.0 Build 148 New content & bugfix patch[/b][/u] 🚀

[b]CONTENT[/b]
[list]
[*] New mission – Dude, where’s my oxygen?!
[*] New language option – Japanese
[/list]

[b]BALANCE[/b]
[list]
[*] Rebalanced the sudden-death events
[/list]

[b]BUGFIXES[/b]
[list]
[*] Missions menu cards are now clickable
[*] Gameplay GIFs can now be posted to socials multiple times
[*] Fix for Polish font missing a character
[*] Other minor fixes

Stay vigilant in space, good luck with the new mission and happy New Lunar Year!

notes.title: Balance & Bugfix #3
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30837263/fa74dc0290194b79824e32ab36fabbdeb589f17e.jpg[/img]

Astrocitizens! Assemble!

Our work here is not done, just yet! We are still working hard to iron out any issues that might prevent you from reaching your destination 60 parsecs away safe and sound! If you spot anything out of the ordinary - please let us know!

If you visited our lovely Parsecs booth at PGA Poznań (pictured!) you will also know that we are still working on the POLISH version of the game, as promised! It will be out as soon, as it's all ready and we're happy with the quality of the text.

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Species of Eight
notes.content:
It’s another transitional time, view-chums, when the students are settling, the returning TV dramas are nervously eyeing up various sharks, and I must decide which of my first ever batch of plants must be sacrificed to the ice gods. Will it be Younas, the defiant mortar tomato? Surely it couldn’t be Wilfred, producer of the Great Unexpected October Chilli? Oh, the terrible burden of choice!

Fortunately, the demands of the column have prepared me, and in fact this time we’re having not five, not ten, but eight of the best overlooked games on Steam. Nobody tells Unknown Pleasures what to do. Except Graham. And Alice. And sometimes Brendy. And the magistrate that one time.

Making a noble sacrifice this week: Genetic meddling, smooth transitions, and Wooian manshoots. (more…)

notes.title: 60 Parsecs! is a space-age survival game from the maker of 60 Seconds!
notes.content:
60 Seconds! studio Robot Gentleman announced today that its upcoming space-age survival adventure 60 Parsecs! will released on Steam on September 18. Similar to its predecessor, 60 Parsecs! will give intrepid, Cold War-era astronauts just 60 seconds to collect supplies from a doomed space station, which they'll have to rely on to survive a journey to a new, less apocalyptically-pancaked world. 

The game will unfold over two distinct phases: The 60-second, "grab what you can" scavenging bit, and then the more drawn-out escape, a "procedurally generated choose-your-own-adventure," fraught with hunger, hard feelings, hostile aliens, and more. Extra supplies can be discovered by exploring new worlds encountered along the way, but of course that opens the door to all sorts of potential new trouble. 

"You'll have to make tough calls each day as you decide who to feed with dwindling food supplies, who to send on supply-gathering missions, and who to toss out the airlock when brain slugs come a-callin," Robot Gentleman said. And once things go sideways, they tend to stay that way: 60 Parsecs! is a "very-much-permadeath adventure." 

60 Parsecs! will go for $15. Hit up robotgentleman.com to find out more.
